products.name: Keyar DT Lite®
products.description: The Keyar DT Lite connects wirelessly to a mobile app, enabling recording of fetal heartbeats, conducting Non Stress Tests (NST), and sharing real-time reports with doctors and specialists.

products.name: JPD-100E
products.description: The device uses a 2.5 MHz ultrasound transducer to detect fetal heartbeats. Results are shown in real time on its LCD screen, with heartbeat values, waveforms and audio output.
features: Detects fetal heartbeat clearly from the 16th week of pregnancy.
Lightweight and portable for home or clinical use.

products.name: MOMI®
products.description: Titanium ring that continuously monitors vital signs.
features: Dedicated modes for pregnancy, postpartum and daily health.
Tracks sleep quality, stress levels, nutrition, and activity.
Battery life of 7+ days with water resistance up to 50m.

products.name: Bempu TempWatch®
products.description:
A simple wristband tracks a newborn’s temperature:
Blinks blue if adequately warm
Blinks red and plays alert sounds if cold
features: Easy to use, in home or clinics
Validated use for 60,000 babies in 14 countries
Available in both single-use and cost-saving multi-use options.
